rappel_detail.anchor: slings on rock or trees; bring cord to build or back up
rappel_detail.station: The ridge crest near 5,400 ft, reached after the south ridge, the pocket glacier and the glacier-polished slabs.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel down broken terrain toward Summit Chief Valley. Depending on the line taken and where the rope lands, a second rappel may be needed before the goat-ledge traverse.
hazards: The slabs above this station can be wet, snow-covered or icy well into summer.

set.rappel_count_note: The descent is reported as one or two rappels from the ridge crest near 5,400 ft into Summit Chief Valley. The table lists the one rappel every party makes; plan for a second. Lengths are not published.
